title: Hyper Reverthion
native_title: ハイパー・リヴァーシオン
overview:
New 3D frontier: light-speed versus battles are here!

Supports the link cable!! Players can battle each other!

Pilot a Thangwu, a winged war creature, in third-person duels across fully 3D arenas. Fly, dash and strike as you circle your opponent and wear down their life gauge before time runs out. In the single-player story, a cast of fighters battles for a mysterious power, and each character has an ending of their own.

- One-on-one 3D battles viewed from behind your Thangwu
- Two-player versus play on a single console, or on two linked consoles with the link cable

3D新境地
光速対戦バトル現わる！

対戦ケーブル対応!!
プレイヤー同士で対戦プレイ可能！
